So we will produce a function call for Boston. Then after receiving response, we produce another function call for San Francisco. Then after receiving both results, we produce a normal text answer summarizing both.

Thus we need to produce a function call for Boston. Then after receiving result, produce function call for San Francisco. Then after receiving result, produce normal text. That seems correct.
